Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
theve...@my-deja.com wrote:
> so that would be different to using a Rat's Warning (or FA or Guard
> Dogs) in which case you would have to untap again?

Yes. Tapped minions cannot block, barring explicit card text to
the contrary.
